title: The Golden Rule as a Heuristic to Measure the Fairness of Texts Using Machine Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Applying the Golden Rule heuristic using a Masked Language Model (ALBERT) to predict masked words in template sentences (e.g., 'a man would [MASK] like to be murdered') to categorize described acts and social interactions as fair or unfair.

Proposed theoretically as a use-case where the Golden Rule framework can identify and counteract anti-social dataset biases, specifically evaluating text that might praise harming individuals based on their race.
